cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to speak up for family. Leave quiz night early for your sister's first exhibition—mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm captain. They'll think I've abandoned them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're finally taking a team seriously. Tell them your sister needs you tonight; then appoint someone to finish the quiz.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave after round one and say I've got a headache.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After round one is fine. But I didn't teach you to hide behind a headache. Tell them you're coming for me; let your team hear who comes first.
